attributes.additional_details: The SEND system needs reform because young people aren’t always getting the support they need. I’ve experienced this firsthand with my exams, which wouldn’t have happened if I didn’t have additional needs. The pressure during exams is overwhelming and causes stress and anxiety, especially for those who aren’t academically gifted. This is unfair and unjust, as our country forces young people to the limit constantly which is not right!
attributes.background: SEND System needs reforming and so does the examination system

rejection.details:
We understand that you would like more support for students with SEND and a change in school examinations. However, we are not sure exactly what you'd like the Government to do.

You may wish to sign the following petitions:

Review SATs and GCSEs to reduce exam reliance and increase inclusive assessment: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/765125

Mandate SEND-awareness training for all staff in schools in England
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778895
